name: cloudflare-access
title: Cloudflare Access
description: Cloudflare Zero Trust identity for Lunora — verify the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion JWT against your team JWKS and feed the verified identity into ctx.auth via a resolveIdentity adapter. Gating the Studio on an Access group is a separate opt-in wiring (accessAdminGate), not scaffolded here.

envVars.name: CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN
envVars.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain (e.g. 'acme' or 'acme.cloudflareaccess.com')

envVars.name: CF_ACCESS_AUD
envVars.description: The Access application AUD tag from the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard
